_comment: Manual photo corrections, applied last by scripts/avto_photos.py (and fetch_images.py) on every run. Key = photos.json key (normalised: uppercase, no spaces/dashes). Value = null to DELETE a bad auto-match, or a full photo object {url, source, make, model} to force one. Keys starting with _ are ignored.
_GGA10_reason: GGA10 is the Toyota Mark X ZiO minivan. SEV-000740/741/742 are all 'Toyota Mark X' but publish 'GGA10, GRX121, GRX133' as their code, and GGA10 leads — so a code-first lookup puts a minivan on all three. Still required after the move to auction photos (2026-08): the feed matches GGA10 to a real ZiO, which is right for the code but wrong for the register entry. Deleting the key now falls through to GRX121, which has its own exact Mark X sedan photo from the feed — a better result than the old make/model fallback.
